name: qissa
description: Qissa — AI early-literacy companion for children in Lahore and beyond. Pedagogy is deterministic code; the LLM only ever generates language.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @qissa/server" "npm run dev -w @qissa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @qissa/core && npm run build -w @qissa/server && npm run build -w @qissa/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @qissa/core && npm run test -w @qissa/server
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
